sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive on an excellent run, having won their last match and posting five wins in their last six outings (W-D-W-W-W). Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form, having lost their last four games consecutively, so Sandbach will be heavy favourites to extend their lead at the top.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications, with Stafford's recent draw suggesting they may be vulnerable. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face a tough test away at Eccleshall, who sit fifth but have lost their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, host Wednesfield Community on home soil and will look to capitalise on their recent win. Bilston Town, in sixth, take on Foley Meir at home as both teams search for consistency. Barnton travel to Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table sides, while New Mills face Market Drayton Town away in what is a crucial contest for both teams battling in the lower half. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second from bottom, visit Telford Town in a basement clash between two struggling sides. Widnes Town, pointless at the bottom with just 2 points, travel to Brereton Social and face another tough assignment. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two sides in the lower reaches of the table.
